title: AnythingLLM 1.14.2
body_markdown:
Just some small patches for the upcoming 1.15.0 / 2.0.0-preview initial release for desktop


## What's Changed


- Migrate AWS Sdk to OpenAI by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5848](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5848)
- Groq STT by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5853](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5853)
- Fix edit prompt not appearing on user prompt by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5861](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5861)
- add missing headers to ollama embeder engine isAlive method by[@TomaszZakrzewski](https://github.com/TomaszZakrzewski) in[#5863](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5863)
- docs: update collector language in project structure by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#5866](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5866)
- Fix attached file context and citations in empty workspace and agent chat by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#5849](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5849)
- Only show mass thread delete on hover by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5871](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5871)
- add Brave Search provider by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5872](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5872)
- feat: add fastCRW web search provider by[@us](https://github.com/us) in[#5824](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5824)
- fix: omit temperature for opus 4.7/4.8 in anthropic llm provider by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#5882](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5882)
- 1.14.2 by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#5897](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5897)


## New Contributors


- [@TomaszZakrzewski](https://github.com/TomaszZakrzewski) made their first contribution in[#5863](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/5863)
